Title: Implement IR verifier core (CFG/SSA/PHI/terminators)
Body:
## Summary
Implement the IR verifier runtime (not just headers) for:
- verify_cfg
- verify_ssa
- verify_phi_wellformed
- verify_terminators
- verify_function_ir aggregator

## Scope
- Enforce invariants:
  - every BB ends with exactly one terminator
  - successor/predecessor consistency
  - entry BB has no predecessors
  - no undefined vreg uses
  - no multi-def per SSA value
  - PHI arity == predecessor count
  - PHI incoming preds are unique and valid
  - PHI incoming type compatibility
  - branch condition type correctness
  - return type correctness

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/verify negative suite passes
- [ ] tests/verify-positive suite passes
- [ ] valid IR exits 0, invalid exits non-zero
- [ ] diagnostics include function + block context

## Summary

## Proposed IDs
- E_TERM_001 missing terminator
- E_TERM_002 multiple terminators
- E_CFG_001 unknown successor block
- E_CFG_002 entry has predecessors
- E_CFG_003 pred/succ mismatch
- E_SSA_001 undefined value use
- E_SSA_002 multiple defs of SSA value
- E_PHI_001 arity mismatch
- E_PHI_002 unknown phi predecessor
- E_PHI_003 duplicate phi predecessor
- E_PHI_004 incoming type mismatch
- E_PHI_005 phi ordering violation
- E_TYPE_001 branch condition not i1
- E_TYPE_002 return type mismatch

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] each verifier error emits stable ID
- [ ] fixture substring matching remains stable
- [ ] docs updated
